# MACHIYA INNS & HOTELS

> > Traditional Japanese machiya townhouse accommodations across Kyoto, Kanazawa, and Takayama

MACHIYA INNS & HOTELS preserves and operates authentic machiya (traditional Japanese townhouses) as boutique accommodations and vacation rentals. The company offers Residence Inn properties and boutique hotels in historic districts near landmarks like Nijo Castle, Gion, Kiyomizu Temple, and Omicho Market.
